title: 회사와 명절에서 부르는 말: 누구를 뭐라고 불러요?
objective: You can choose the right title for each person, such as 과장님, 선배님, 고모, or 외삼촌.
summary: This worksheet shows how Koreans address coworkers and relatives with titles.
note: The team memo is a sample written for practice. The people and names are not real.

task.title: Choose the right title
task.line: Use the word list, the memo, and the tips box to decide what to call each person.

sections.heading: Who is who? Titles at work and in the family

items.text: Add 님 to a senior's job title and use it instead of the person's name.
Use the given name or full name + 씨 for coworkers at your level or below, but never for seniors.
Use it for someone who joined before you, especially when they have no job title.
Use it for your father's older brother.
Use it after he marries. Before that, he is usually called 삼촌.
Use it for your father's sister, older or younger.
Use it for your mother's sister. People also use it casually for women working in small restaurants.
items.example: 이모, 여기 김치 좀 더 주세요.

items.text: Use it for your mother's brother. 외- means the mother's side.
Use it for the child of any aunt or uncle. Add 형, 누나, 동생, and so on to be more specific.

sections.heading: Read: A new employee's memo
paragraphs: 박정호 팀장님: 우리 팀에서 제일 높은 분. 이름 말고 "팀장님"이라고 부르기.
이수진 과장님: 일을 가르쳐 주시는 분. "과장님"이라고 부르기.
최준영 대리님, 김하늘 대리님: 대리님이 두 분이라서 "최 대리님", "김 대리님"이라고 부르기.

sections.heading: How is this different from your country?
paragraphs: At work, Koreans rarely call a senior by name. Use title + 님 (팀장님, 과장님). Surname + 씨 alone (이 씨, 김 씨) can sound rude, and 당신 is not used to address a coworker.
In the family, Korean has a different word for each relative. Ask yourself two questions: Is it the father's side or the mother's side (외-)? Is the person older or younger, and married or not?

exercises: Write the family title in Korean: ① 엄마의 언니 ② 아빠의 형 ③ 아빠의 여동생 ④ 엄마의 남동생
Read the memo and write how to address 김하늘 대리님 at work: "____, 보고서 확인 부탁드립니다."
Write O if it is polite and correct, X if it is not: ① 입사 동기에게 "유나 씨"라고 불러요. ② 과장님에게 "이 씨"라고 불러요. ③ 식당에서 일하는 아주머니에게 "이모"라고 불러요. ④ 아빠의 결혼 안 한 남동생을 "큰아버지"라고 불러요.
Read and answer in English: 제 사촌은 이모의 딸이에요. Is this cousin on the mother's side or the father's side?

Fill in the blank with the word from the word list that means "senior colleague." The person joined the team two years before you and has no job title, and you speak politely to them: "____, 이 서류는 어디에 두면 돼요?"
answers: ① 이모 ② 큰아버지 ③ 고모 ④ 외삼촌
① O ② X ③ O ④ X
The mother's side (이모 is the mother's sister).
